FC-10A.title: Figure C-10A: PS Loose (printed C-28, PDF 142)
FC-10A.legend_hint: the triangles are the only symbols on this figure
FC-10A.notes_for_reviewers: Computer-plotted failure envelope of the PS loose direct shear tests: shear strength against normal stress, both axes printed in tens of psf (x 10^1), which does not matter for the answers. The triangles are the measured peak shear stresses; the straight line is the least-squares fit drawn through them, and a triangle need not sit on it. The box above the plot prints the fitted values. A triangle's center can be its middle or its centroid; both count.
